about.title: Acerca de
about.paragraph1: [ES] RTB0 is a state-of-the-art platform designed to enhance digital advertising by facilitating the buying and selling of traffic using the Real-Time Bidding (RTB) protocol.
about.paragraph2: [ES] Unlike traditional ad exchanges, RTB0 leverages the power of real-time bidding, allowing advertisers to bid on individual ad impressions as they become available.
about.paragraph3: [ES] RTB0 is built with a focus on flexibility and ease of use. There are no complex setups or dependencies required to get started.

features.config: [ES] Flexible Configuration — Easily customize the platform to fit your needs.
